auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the work email your administrator registered.
auth.magicLinkSent: If this email is registered, a sign-in link is on its way.
auth.inactiveBody: Your login exists but is not linked to an active employee, or it has been suspended. Contact your administrator.
auth.otpSent: If this email is registered, a sign-in code is on its way. Enter it below.
auth.otpHint: The numeric code from the email. Use it in this app; the link in the same email opens the phone's browser instead.
auth.otpInvalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.

users.name: Name
users.rolesUnavailable: Role assignments could not be loaded.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.name: Name
roles.ownerNote: The owner role always has every permission and cannot be edited.
roles.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, e.g. area_manager
roles.readOnly: You can view this role but not change it.
roles.ceilingNote: You can only grant a permission at a scope and limit you hold yourself, and you can't change a role you hold.
roles.sensitiveHint: Changing this raises a critical security event.

security.title: Security events
security.latest: Latest {count} events. Times are Cairo time.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You don't have permission to open this page. Ask an administrator if you need it.

common.reasonPlaceholder: Why? This is kept in the security log.
common.errorTitle: This page could not be shown
common.errorBody: Something went wrong while loading. Please try again.

userDetail.title: Access for {name}
userDetail.noAssignments: This user has no active roles, so they can't use anything yet.
userDetail.grantHint: You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself at the same or a wider scope.
userDetail.territoriesUnavailable: Territories could not be loaded; you can still grant without a territory.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.intro: Creates the employee record, emails an invitation and links the login. The new user has no access until you grant a role.
invite.inviteFailed: The employee record was created, but the invitation email could not be sent. Submitting again retries only the invitation.
invite.linkFailed: The invitation was sent, but the login could not be linked to the employee. Until it is linked the person cannot access anything. Submitting again retries only the link.
invite.resumeNotice: The employee record already exists, so its details are locked.

errors.MANAGER_CYCLE: That manager reports (directly or indirectly) to this employee. Choose someone else.
errors.TERRITORY_CYCLE: A territory can't move under itself or one of its sub-territories.
errors.TERRITORY_TOO_DEEP: Territories have at most three levels: region, area and sub-area.
errors.TERRITORY_HAS_CHILDREN: Deactivate or move its sub-territories first.
errors.SETTING_NOT_WHITELISTED: This setting can't be changed here.
errors.SETTING_OUT_OF_RANGE: That value is outside the allowed range.
errors.SETTING_SECRET_REFUSED: That looks like a password or key. Secrets never go in settings.

settings.title: System settings
settings.intro: Company-wide rules the system applies. Every change is logged with who made it and why.
settings.ownerOnlyHint: Settings marked “Owner only” (tracking, payments, commissions, tax and data retention) can only be changed by an owner.
settings.fixedHint: This value is fixed for the whole system and can't be changed.
settings.notWhitelistedHint: This value has no definition yet, so nobody can change it from here.
settings.reasonPlaceholder: Why? This is kept in the security log.

employees.title: Employees
employees.intro: Organisation records: manager chain, department, office and territories. A job title grants no access; roles do.
employees.territoriesUnavailable: Territory assignments could not be loaded.
employees.name: Name

employeeForm.introNew: Creates the organisation record only. Give them a login from Users → Invite, and access through roles.
employeeForm.listsUnavailable: Some lists could not be loaded; you can still save the basic details.
employeeForm.jobTitleHint: For display only: it grants no access.
employeeForm.selfScopeLocked: Your own manager and department decide what you can see, so only an owner can change them.
employeeForm.managerHint: People who report to this employee are not offered, so the chain can't loop.

employeeDetail.loginLinked: Has a login: open access settings
employeeDetail.noLogin: No login yet. Invite them from Users.
employeeDetail.heldTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Customers held} one {# customer held} other {# customers held}}
employeeDetail.heldHint: Nothing is reassigned automatically. Hand these customers over through a customer reassignment before or after a deactivation.
employeeDetail.statusHint: Suspended employees and those who left lose all access at once. Their customers, reports and territories stay as they are.
employeeDetail.statusHeldWarning: {count, plural, one {They still hold # customer (listed above).} other {They still hold # customers (listed above).}}
employeeDetail.statusReportsWarning: {count, plural, one {# person reports to them; assign a new manager separately.} other {# people report to them; assign a new manager separately.}}
employeeDetail.selfStatus: You can't change your own employment status.
employeeDetail.territoriesHint: Territory assignments decide which customers someone with territory scope can see.
employeeDetail.noTerritoryChoices: Every active territory is already assigned.
employeeDetail.selfTerritories: Your own territories decide what you can see, so only an owner can change them.
employeeDetail.reportsTitle: {count, plural, one {# direct report} other {# direct reports}}

territories.title: Territories
territories.intro: Regions, areas and sub-areas, the governorates and cities they cover, and how many customers each holds. New customers are placed by this coverage.
territories.countsUnavailable: Customer counts could not be loaded.
territories.unassigned: {count, plural, one {# customer has no territory.} other {# customers have no territory.}}
territories.customers: {count, plural, =0 {No customers} one {# customer} other {# customers}}
territories.customersTotal: {count, plural, one {# with sub-territories} other {# with sub-territories}}
territories.employees: {count, plural, =0 {no staff} one {# staff member} other {# staff}}
territories.moveHint: Sub-territories move with it. Places that would loop or exceed three levels are not offered.
territories.deactivateHint: Customers, staff assignments and coverage stay where they are; new customers are no longer placed here.
territories.hasChildren: Has active sub-territories, so it can't be deactivated.
territories.createHint: Leave the parent empty to create a region.
territories.createHintScoped: You can create territories inside the ones you manage.
territories.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. CAI-EAST. It can't be changed later.
territories.coverageHint: Which territory a new customer joins, by governorate and city. A city rule beats the whole-governorate rule.
territories.coverageEmpty: No coverage yet: new customers fall back to their creator's territory.
territories.cityHint: Leave empty for the whole governorate.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.ESCALATION_BLOCKED: You can't grant access you don't hold yourself.
errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only an owner can do that.
errors.SELF_GRANT_FORBIDDEN: You can't change your own access.
errors.LAST_OWNER: At least one active owner must remain.
errors.OWNER_ROLE_PROTECTED: The owner role can't be changed.
errors.INVALID_STATE: That action isn't possible in the current state.
errors.VALIDATION: Please check the values you entered.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone else changed this record. Reload and try again.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED: This action needs a code from your authenticator app. Open My security (Account security), verify this session, then try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
